L-6.note: 'continue <drug> at 12' is the approved incomplete-rate question; '... at 12 mcg/min' is valid

statement: The demonstrated order semantics that could execute the wrong vasoactive rate, attribute another drug's rate, stop the wrong infusion, make an incomplete order executable or bypass the defense in depth are closed: a rate and a stop belong to one drug (structurally, with no nearest-number heuristic), the unit is required and compatible with the drug, the '/min' of a rate unit is not a duration, a restart or a continue with no rate with its unit is the approved incomplete-rate question, the pipeline barrier reads rate_mcg_min so each barrier of nitroglycerin protects alone, and an answer is one rate with its unit for the drug that asked. The reader freeze was lifted a second time, narrowly: the reader of the first successor and the reader of the Phase-2 closure are rebuilt byte for byte from the live one, every Phase-2 digest recomputes from the closure reader, the calibration freeze moved in exactly one component and nothing sealed was rewritten. One independent adversarial review found 17 behaviors; the material ones (two of them regressions of this very change) were reproduced and repaired and the rest are declared. What remains is low-risk semantics that needs a faculty decision, listed with its exact shape.

why_not_the_others.A: not every limitation is closed: the closed-list recognition of other medicines, the generic time phrases, the ceiling/step/baseline number and the two-infusion non-stop piece remain, each declared with its shape
why_not_the_others.C: the demonstrated gaps were closed with structural rules inside the existing order language; a generic medication-recognition redesign is the only thing that would close L-11 and it is not needed to close what was demonstrated
why_not_the_others.D: the historical reconstruction is exact for both successions: the git blob and SHA-256 of the closure reader and of the first successor are reproduced, every recorded closure digest recomputes with the reader of its time and no sealed record changed
why_not_the_others.E: every material defect the review found was reproduced and repaired inside this package; no unrepaired material order-execution defect remains: what remains needs a faculty decision on clinical semantics and is declared
